mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credential_handles (id, organization_id, name, provider, handle, metadata, secret_ciphertext, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{name}, #{provider}, #{handle}, #{metadata, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{secretCiphertext}, #{createdBy})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM credential_handles WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_profiles (id, organization_id, name, provider, model, credential_handle_id, configuration, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{name}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{credentialHandleId}, #{configuration, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE model_profiles SET name = COALESCE(#{name}, name), provider = COALESCE(#{provider}, provider), model = COALESCE(#{model}, model), credential_handle_id = CASE WHEN #{credentialHandleId} IS NOT NULL OR #{status} IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(#{credentialHandleId}, credential_handle_id) ELSE credential_handle_id END, configuration = COALESCE(#{configuration, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, configuration), status = COALESCE(#{status}, status), updated_at = now() WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM model_profiles WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM credential_handles WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}

SELECT id::text AS id, actor_user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, payload, occurred_at, count(*) OVER()::integer AS total FROM audit_events WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND (#{action}::text IS NULL OR action = #{action}) AND (#{resourceType}::text IS NULL OR resource_type = #{resourceType}) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT i.id, i.organization_id, i.project_id, i.connector_definition_id, i.display_name, i.credential_handle, i.granted_scopes, i.status, i.last_error_code, i.installed_by, i.created_at, i.updated_at, d.name AS connector_name, d.allowed_tools, d.required_scopes FROM connector_installations i JOIN connector_definitions d ON d.id = i.connector_definition_id WHERE i.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND i.status <> 'revoked' ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO connector_installations (id, organization_id, project_id, connector_definition_id, display_name, credential_handle, granted_scopes, status, last_error_code, installed_by) SELECT #{id}, #{organizationId}, #{projectId}, d.id, #{displayName}, #{credentialHandle}, #{grantedScopes, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, CASE WHEN d.status = 'available' THEN 'available' ELSE 'unavailable' END, CASE WHEN d.status = 'available' THEN NULL ELSE 'proxy_unavailable' END, #{userId} FROM connector_definitions d WHERE d.id = #{definitionId} AND (#{projectId}::text IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND p.id = #{projectId})) AND d.required_scopes <@ #{grantedScopes, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}
mapper.select: UPDATE connector_installations SET status = 'revoked', credential_handle = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id} AND status <> 'revoked' RETURNING *
SELECT * FROM schedules WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status <> 'deleted' ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE schedules SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now(), next_run_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'active' THEN GREATEST(next_run_at, now()) ELSE next_run_at END WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id} AND status <> 'deleted'
